about: The kinds of member a space has (src/space-member-types.mjs), as DATA. A member's type is the `role` of their membership row in that space, and the space's rules (src/space-permission-rules.json) name a type by its id in `who: { kind: "member_type", member_type }`. A type can inherit one or more other type ids; inherited permissions include every ancestor, and cycles or missing parents fail closed. Per space label (the membership's `label`, src/network-settings.json membership_labels): `types` in the order they are offered, each { id, label (what the person reads), about (one line on what it is for), inherits? (type ids whose permissions it also takes) }; `joins_as` is the type a person gets when they join (an invite accepted, an invite link used); `earlier_roles` names roles written before types existed and the type each now is, so a member who joined earlier reads as the type they would get now. A label not named here uses `default`; a community's types are its own configured roles (src/community.mjs), not these. Whoever the space's rules let do `set_member_type` gives a member another type; whoever they let do `change_rules` adds a space's own type by its name (at most `own_types.max`, each name at most `own_types.max_label` characters), offered next to these wherever a type is chosen. The person who starts a space is always `owner`.
